body:
![An image of a troll with the text "TrollCommands" below it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/v4xt3ua4/images/a9a72e5a146e069f5790cca9d96797809c67ba9c.png)
# TrollCommands
Ever wanted to mess with people on your server? Now you can! This lightweight and easy-to-use plugin gives you all the tools you need to pull off the ultimate server pranks.

## Commands
Impersonate a user in chat:
> `/spk <player> <message>`

Strike lightning at the block you are looking at:
> `/thor`

Strike lightning on a player:
> `/thor <player>`

Strike lightning on a player and deal damage:
> `/thor <player> <amount>`

Summon a TNT at the block you are looking at:
> `/antioch`

Summon a TNT at a specific player:
> `/antioch <player>`
